headline: Sabres’ top line was on fire in barnburner against Ducks
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that Buffalo's top line carried a 7-6 win over Anaheim on Thursday, with Thompson collecting five points and Krabs and Benson three apiece.

A night like that can make a team look sharper than it is, so here's what our numbers show. So far this season, BUF has taken 50.4% of the expected goals (a measure of chance quality) overall and 52% at five-on-five, so they're an even-to-slightly-better team, not a runaway. They're 6-4-3, and their scoring has actually trailed their chances by 3.3 goals, which suggests the finishing has been unlucky and a night like this could be a correction. The bigger concern is goaltending: BUF's goalies are 3.4 goals saved below expected, which fits a game with six goals against. ANA sits at 46.7% of expected goals and 44% at five-on-five, with goalies 3 goals below expected, so a 5-7-1 record looks about right. Scoring runs hot, defense runs thin, and that's an uneasy mix for both sides.
